DCC Kesling Park Ride

Springboro, OH · Road

No-drop

DCC Kesling Park Ride is a road group ride in Springboro, OH. It rolls every Thursday at 6:00 pm from Kesling Park, front lot by the basketball court. About 25–30 miles, groups from 12–15 mph up to 19+ mph. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 12–15 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the DCC Kesling Park Ride group ride

The Dayton club's Thursday road ride south of town. Several pace groups from 12–15 mph up to 19+, all no-drop. Lights required as evenings shorten.
